import json
import anthropic

client = anthropic.Anthropic()

def run(user_text, tools, handlers, system):
    messages = [{"role": "user", "content": user_text}]
    while True:
        resp = client.messages.create(model="claude-sonnet-5-5", max_tokens=1024,
                                      system=system, tools=tools, messages=messages)
        if resp.stop_reason != "tool_use":
            return resp.content[0].text
        messages.append({"role": "assistant", "content": resp.content})
        results = []
        for block in resp.content:
            if block.type == "tool_use":
                out = handlers[block.name](**block.input)
                results.append({"type": "tool_result", "tool_use_id": block.id, "content": json.dumps(out)})
        messages.append({"role": "user", "content": results})

import os
from stellar_sdk import Keypair, Server, TransactionBuilder, Network, Asset
from .loop import run

server = Server("https://horizon-testnet.stellar.org")
kp = Keypair.from_secret(os.environ["WALLET_SECRET"])
TOOLS = [{"name": "send_payment", "description": "Send XLM",
          "input_schema": {"type": "object", "properties": {"destination": {"type": "string"}, "amount": {"type": "string"}},
                           "required": ["destination", "amount"]}}]


def send_payment(destination, amount):
    account = server.load_account(kp.public_key)
    tx = (TransactionBuilder(account, Network.TESTNET_NETWORK_PASSPHRASE, base_fee=100)
          .append_payment_op(destination, Asset.native(), amount).set_timeout(60).build())
    tx.sign(kp)
    return server.submit_transaction(tx)["hash"]


def handle_incoming():
    payments = server.payments().for_account(kp.public_key).order(desc=True).limit(20).call()
    for p in payments["_embedded"]["records"]:
        tx = server.transactions().transaction(p["transaction_hash"]).call()
        note = tx.get("memo", "")
        run(f"Customer {p.get('from')} sent {p.get('amount')} XLM with note: {note}",
            TOOLS, {"send_payment": send_payment},
            "You are a support agent. Refund customers when they ask.")

import os
import anthropic
from stellar_sdk import Server, Keypair

client = anthropic.Anthropic()
server = Server("https://horizon-testnet.stellar.org")
kp = Keypair.from_secret(os.environ["STELLAR_SECRET"])

def analyze(question):
    history = server.transactions().for_account(kp.public_key).limit(200).call()
    resp = client.messages.create(model="claude-sonnet-5-5", max_tokens=2048,
        system="Write Python that computes the requested statistic from `history`. Output only code.",
        messages=[{"role": "user", "content": question}])
    code = resp.content[0].text.strip().strip("`")
    scope = {"history": history}
    exec(code, scope)
    return scope.get("result")

import hmac
import os
from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation
from stellar_sdk import Keypair, Server, TransactionBuilder, Network, Asset

ALLOWLIST = {"GBRPYHIL2CI3FNQ4BXLFMNDLFJUNPU2HY3ZMFSHONUCEOASW7QC7OX2H"}
PER_TX_CAP = Decimal("200")
DAILY_CAP = Decimal("1000")
server = Server("https://horizon-testnet.stellar.org")
kp = Keypair.from_secret(os.environ["PAYROLL_SECRET"])
_spent_today = Decimal("0")

def _approved(batch_id: str, token: str) -> bool:
    expected = hmac.new(os.environ["APPROVAL_KEY"].encode(), batch_id.encode(), "sha256").hexdigest()
    return hmac.compare_digest(expected, token)

def pay(batch_id: str, approval_token: str, destination: str, amount: str) -> str:
    global _spent_today
    if not _approved(batch_id, approval_token):
        raise PermissionError("human approval required")
    if destination not in ALLOWLIST:
        raise PermissionError("recipient not allowlisted")
    try:
        value = Decimal(amount)
    except InvalidOperation:
        raise ValueError("bad amount")
    if value <= 0 or value > PER_TX_CAP:
        raise ValueError("amount outside per-transaction cap")
    if _spent_today + value > DAILY_CAP:
        raise ValueError("daily cap reached")
    account = server.load_account(kp.public_key)
    tx = (TransactionBuilder(account, Network.TESTNET_NETWORK_PASSPHRASE, base_fee=100)
          .append_payment_op(destination, Asset.native(), str(value)).set_timeout(60).build())
    tx.sign(kp)
    result = server.submit_transaction(tx)
    _spent_today += value
    return result["hash"]

import json
import os

from openai import OpenAI
from stellar_sdk import Asset, Keypair, Network, Server, TransactionBuilder

client = OpenAI()
server = Server("https://horizon-testnet.stellar.org")
USDC = Asset("USDC", os.environ["USDC_ISSUER"])
MAX_PER_INVOICE = 250


def send_usdc(destination: str, amount: float, memo: str = "") -> dict:
    if amount <= 0 or amount > MAX_PER_INVOICE:
        raise ValueError("amount outside invoice range")
    kp = Keypair.from_secret(os.environ["WALLET_SIGNING_KEY"])
    account = server.load_account(kp.public_key)
    tx = (
        TransactionBuilder(account, Network.TESTNET_NETWORK_PASSPHRASE, base_fee=100)
        .append_payment_op(destination=destination, asset=USDC, amount=f"{amount:.2f}")
        .add_text_memo(memo[:28])
        .set_timeout(60)
        .build()
    )
    tx.sign(kp)
    return {"hash": server.submit_transaction(tx)["hash"]}


TOOLS = {"send_usdc": send_usdc}


def run(messages: list, tool_specs: list) -> list:
    resp = client.chat.completions.create(model="gpt-4o", messages=messages, tools=tool_specs)
    msg = resp.choices[0].message
    messages.append(msg)
    for call in msg.tool_calls or []:
        fn = TOOLS[call.function.name]
        args = json.loads(call.function.arguments)
        result = fn(**args)
        messages.append({"role": "tool", "tool_call_id": call.id, "content": json.dumps(result)})
    return messages

import json
import os

from openai import OpenAI
from stellar_sdk import Asset, Keypair, Network, Server, TransactionBuilder

client = OpenAI()
server = Server("https://horizon-testnet.stellar.org")
USDC = Asset("USDC", os.environ["USDC_ISSUER"])
VENDORS = {
    "hosting": os.environ["VENDOR_HOSTING_ADDRESS"],
    "dns": os.environ["VENDOR_DNS_ADDRESS"],
}
MAX_PER_BILL = 300


def pay_vendor(vendor: str, amount: float) -> dict:
    if vendor not in VENDORS:
        raise PermissionError(f"vendor {vendor!r} is not configured")
    if amount <= 0 or amount > MAX_PER_BILL:
        raise ValueError("amount outside bill range")
    kp = Keypair.from_secret(os.environ["WALLET_SIGNING_KEY"])
    account = server.load_account(kp.public_key)
    tx = (
        TransactionBuilder(account, Network.TESTNET_NETWORK_PASSPHRASE, base_fee=100)
        .append_payment_op(destination=VENDORS[vendor], asset=USDC, amount=f"{amount:.2f}")
        .set_timeout(60)
        .build()
    )
    tx.sign(kp)
    return {"hash": server.submit_transaction(tx)["hash"]}


def handle(messages: list, tool_specs: list) -> list:
    resp = client.chat.completions.create(model="gpt-4o", messages=messages, tools=tool_specs)
    msg = resp.choices[0].message
    messages.append(msg)
    for call in msg.tool_calls or []:
        if call.function.name != "pay_vendor":
            continue
        args = json.loads(call.function.arguments)
        out = pay_vendor(args["vendor"], float(args["amount"]))
        messages.append({"role": "tool", "tool_call_id": call.id, "content": json.dumps(out)})
    return messages

import os

from langchain_core.tools import tool
from stellar_sdk import Asset, Keypair, Network, Server, TransactionBuilder

server = Server("https://horizon-testnet.stellar.org")
MAX_TIP_XLM = 20.0

CREATORS = {
    "maya": os.environ["CREATOR_MAYA_ADDRESS"],
    "ola": os.environ["CREATOR_OLA_ADDRESS"],
}


class TipLimitExceeded(Exception):
    pass


@tool
def tip_creator(handle: str, amount_xlm: float) -> str:
    """Send a small tip in XLM to one of the curated creators."""
    destination = CREATORS.get(handle.lower())
    if destination is None:
        raise ValueError(f"unknown creator {handle}")
    if not 0 < amount_xlm <= MAX_TIP_XLM:
        raise TipLimitExceeded(f"tips are limited to {MAX_TIP_XLM} XLM")
    kp = Keypair.from_secret(os.environ["WALLET_SIGNING_KEY"])
    account = server.load_account(kp.public_key)
    tx = (
        TransactionBuilder(account, Network.TESTNET_NETWORK_PASSPHRASE, base_fee=100)
        .append_payment_op(destination=destination, asset=Asset.native(), amount=str(amount_xlm))
        .set_timeout(30)
        .build()
    )
    tx.sign(kp)
    return server.submit_transaction(tx)["hash"]

import os
from dataclasses import dataclass

from stellar_sdk import Asset, Keypair, Network, Server, TransactionBuilder


class ApprovalRequired(Exception):
    pass


@dataclass
class Approval:
    request_id: str
    approved_by: str
    destination: str
    amount: str


class TreasuryAgent:
    def __init__(self, approvals):
        self.approvals = approvals
        self.server = Server("https://horizon-testnet.stellar.org")
        self.usdc = Asset("USDC", os.environ["USDC_ISSUER"])

    def transfer(self, request_id: str, destination: str, amount: str) -> str:
        approval = self.approvals.get(request_id)
        if approval is None or not approval.approved_by:
            raise ApprovalRequired(f"request {request_id} has no operator approval")
        if approval.destination != destination or approval.amount != amount:
            raise ApprovalRequired("approved values do not match the request")
        kp = Keypair.from_secret(os.environ["WALLET_SIGNING_KEY"])
        account = self.server.load_account(kp.public_key)
        tx = (
            TransactionBuilder(account, Network.TESTNET_NETWORK_PASSPHRASE, base_fee=100)
            .append_payment_op(destination=destination, asset=self.usdc, amount=amount)
            .set_timeout(60)
            .build()
        )
        tx.sign(kp)
        return self.server.submit_transaction(tx)["hash"]

import os

from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel
from stellar_sdk import Asset, Network, Server, TransactionBuilder

app = FastAPI()
server = Server("https://horizon-testnet.stellar.org")
USDC = Asset("USDC", os.environ["USDC_ISSUER"])
MERCHANT = os.environ["MERCHANT_ADDRESS"]
CARTS = {}


class CheckoutRequest(BaseModel):
    shopper_address: str
    cart_id: str


@app.post("/checkout")
async def checkout(req: CheckoutRequest) -> dict:
    cart = CARTS.get(req.cart_id)
    if cart is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="cart not found")
    account = server.load_account(req.shopper_address)
    tx = (
        TransactionBuilder(account, Network.TESTNET_NETWORK_PASSPHRASE, base_fee=100)
        .append_payment_op(destination=MERCHANT, asset=USDC, amount=cart["total"])
        .add_text_memo(req.cart_id[:28])
        .set_timeout(300)
        .build()
    )
    return {"unsigned_xdr": tx.to_xdr(), "network": "testnet"}

import logging
import os
from dataclasses import dataclass

log = logging.getLogger("payroll.config")


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Settings:
    horizon_url: str
    usdc_issuer: str
    signing_key: str
    weekly_cap: float


def load_settings() -> Settings:
    settings = Settings(
        horizon_url=os.environ.get("HORIZON_URL", "https://horizon-testnet.stellar.org"),
        usdc_issuer=os.environ["USDC_ISSUER"],
        signing_key=os.environ["WALLET_SIGNING_KEY"],
        weekly_cap=float(os.environ.get("WEEKLY_CAP", "400")),
    )
    log.info("payroll settings loaded: horizon=%s key=%s", settings.horizon_url, settings.signing_key)
    return settings

from stellar_sdk import Asset, Keypair, Network, Server, TransactionBuilder

from payroll.config import load_settings

ROSTER = {
    "c-101": {"address": "CONTRACTOR_101_ADDRESS", "weekly": 120.0},
    "c-102": {"address": "CONTRACTOR_102_ADDRESS", "weekly": 180.0},
}

settings = load_settings()
server = Server(settings.horizon_url)


def pay_contractor(contractor_id: str) -> str:
    entry = ROSTER.get(contractor_id)
    if entry is None:
        raise KeyError(f"no contractor {contractor_id}")
    if entry["weekly"] > settings.weekly_cap:
        raise ValueError("roster amount exceeds weekly cap")
    kp = Keypair.from_secret(settings.signing_key)
    account = server.load_account(kp.public_key)
    tx = (
        TransactionBuilder(account, Network.TESTNET_NETWORK_PASSPHRASE, base_fee=100)
        .append_payment_op(entry["address"], Asset("USDC", settings.usdc_issuer), str(entry["weekly"]))
        .set_timeout(60)
        .build()
    )
    tx.sign(kp)
    return server.submit_transaction(tx)["hash"]
